title.en: Rotterdam Convention on Prior Informed Consent (PIC)
title.hi: पूर्व सूचित सहमति (PIC) प्रक्रिया पर रॉटरडैम कन्वेंशन

definition.en: The Rotterdam Convention (1998, in force 2004) fosters shared responsibility and cooperative efforts in the international trade of certain hazardous pesticides and industrial chemicals to protect human health and the environment.
definition.hi: The Rotterdam Convention (1998, in force 2004) fosters shared responsibility and cooperative efforts in the international trade of certain hazardous pesticides and industrial chemicals to protect human health and the environment.

content.en: The Rotterdam Convention (1998, in force 2004) fosters shared responsibility and cooperative efforts in the international trade of certain hazardous pesticides and industrial chemicals to protect human health and the environment.
content.hi: The Rotterdam Convention (1998, in force 2004) fosters shared responsibility and cooperative efforts in the international trade of certain hazardous pesticides and industrial chemicals to protect human health and the environment.

content.en:
• Operates the legally binding Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure for listed chemicals.
• Covers banned or severely restricted pesticides and hazardous formulations.
• Does NOT ban chemicals; enables importing countries to make informed decisions and reject imports.
• Facilitates information exchange through Decision Guidance Documents (DGDs).
content.hi:
• Operates the legally binding Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure for listed chemicals.
• Covers banned or severely restricted pesticides and hazardous formulations.
• Does NOT ban chemicals; enables importing countries to make informed decisions and reject imports.

question.en: Does the Rotterdam Convention completely ban the global manufacture of hazardous industrial chemicals listed in Annex III?
question.hi: Does the Rotterdam Convention completely ban the global manufacture of hazardous industrial chemicals listed in Annex III?

text.en: No, it enforces the Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure, not an outright ban
text.hi: No, it enforces the Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure, not an outright ban

text.en: Yes, but only for developing countries
text.hi: Yes, but only for developing countries

text.en: No, it applies only to radioactive substances
text.hi: No, it applies only to radioactive substances

explanation.en: The Rotterdam Convention does not ban chemicals; it establishes a legally binding Prior Informed Consent (PIC) mechanism so countries receive advance notice and can decide whether to accept or refuse imports.
explanation.hi: The Rotterdam Convention does not ban chemicals; it establishes a legally binding Prior Informed Consent (PIC) mechanism so countries receive advance notice and can decide whether to accept or refuse imports.
